title: AI VTuber Speech Observation Batch
description: Provider-neutral, bounded speech observations (issue #92, slice S1): raw speech-activity edges and an optional turn-end score for one pseudonymous speaker. Serialized form of aivtuber_domain::SpeechObservationBatch. Observation data only: it carries no authority, no priority and no trust claim (the receiving ingress assigns source class, plane and trust, and a microphone speaker is always untrusted content-plane input, even the operator's). There is no raw audio, PCM or transcript text in this contract (transcripts are a later slice). Times are integer milliseconds on the monotonic or logical timeline of the receiving runtime, already mapped there by the adapter; never wall-clock time. The batch declares its language by configuration; it is never inferred.

schema_version.description: Contract version. An incompatible version is refused rather than reinterpreted.

provider_id.description: Adapter or provider that produced the observations (for example a VAD sidecar). Audit data.

provider_version.description: Provider/model build identity. Two VAD versions behaved materially differently in EXP-0001, so it is always recorded.

language.description: Language the provider was *configured* for (for example ja). Declared, never inferred: no measured provider detects language.

observations.description: Observations in producer order. Bounded; per-speaker ordering is by observed_at_ms, never by arrival.

speaker_id.description: Pseudonymous speaker or session id assigned by the adapter. Not a name, not an account id, not a voiceprint.

edge.description: Raw activity edge. No debounce or minimum-speech filter is applied (ADR-0005): a short fragment is still an edge.

expires_at_ms.description: Optional absolute expiry on the same timeline; must be after observed_at_ms and at most 60000 ms later. It can only tighten the runtime's max age, never extend it. The cross-field rule is not expressible in JSON Schema; the Rust validator and scripts/validate.mjs enforce it.

confidence.description: Optional frame confidence. Provider-specific and not calibrated across model versions.

calibrated.description: Whether the score is a calibrated probability. Defaults to false; a consumer must not treat an uncalibrated score as a probability (EXP-0001 11.1).

score.description: Provider score in [0, 1]. A nowcast (has the turn ended now) unless prediction_horizon_ms is present.

prediction_horizon_ms.description: Present only when the provider actually predicts ahead. Absent for a nowcast; no measured provider predicts.
